blocks.text: Buying a Strata Townhome in Maple Ridge: Benchmarks & Top Areas

parts.t: Townhomes are one of Maple Ridge's fastest-growing housing segments, offering three- and four-bedroom family layouts with attached garages at a substantial discount to detached homes. According to the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® October 2026 MLS® HPI, the benchmark price for a strata townhome in Maple Ridge is $686,600.

Cottonwood has the highest share of row houses in the city (29.9% of dwellings in the 2021 Census), followed closely by Albion, Silver Valley, Southwest Maple Ridge (Hammond), and West Central. Buyers can compare newer three-level townhomes near c'usqunela Elementary and Kanaka Creek Elementary against spacious two-level or 55+ rancher townhomes in West Central and East Central.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Townhome Strata Due Diligence: CRF, Roofs & Garages

parts.t: Before removing conditions on any Maple Ridge townhome, we review two full years of strata council and AGM/SGM minutes, the Form B Information Certificate (confirming monthly strata fees, Contingency Reserve Fund balance, parking assignments, and any pending special levies), the Depreciation Report, and the strata insurance certificate.

What is the difference between tandem and side-by-side townhome garages?

A tandem garage parks two vehicles end-to-end (one behind the other) and is common in narrower 3-bedroom townhomes, whereas a side-by-side double garage allows both vehicles to enter and exit independently and often includes a full two-car driveway apron.
Are there 55+ age-restricted townhomes in Maple Ridge?

Can I rent out my Maple Ridge townhome or bring pets?

Under BC Strata Property Act rules, strata corporations cannot prohibit long-term residential rentals (though short-term vacation rentals can be banned). Most Maple Ridge townhome stratas allow one or two pets (dogs or cats), though some restrict dog weight or number.
